init_signal_handler: install signal handlers for SLURM pre-emption and time limit signals
init_distributed_mode: initialize distributed PyTorch mode for single, multi-GPU, or multi-node SLURM jobs
run_sig_handler: run the SIGUSR1 signal handler to requeue a SLURM job on the master process
run_term_handler: run the SIGTERM signal handler to bypass termination signals from SLURM
review_init_distributed_mode: review the distributed initialization logic for SLURM, torch.distributed.launch, and single-GPU modes
